# jack/karen
Date: 2026-11-11 | Duration: 10.289999961853027m

## Summary
Website work is progressing, but Jack Ops’ weekly batch remains pending. Alignment with Chris is taking effort because of strong opinions about details, particularly disputed landing-page forms, while the team weighs speed against input and avoids sunk-cost reasoning. Custom landing pages remain the preferred direction, with fewer required fields, custom-code support, and Jack Ops generating tables to reduce user work rather than relying on CMS-generated tables. Chris requested an optional form toggle that would replace the hero image; top placement is preferred, although users may scroll for context, so placement remains testable. Existing forms use HubSpot CSS, which Jack Ops is recreating, and Google Tag Manager form-fill tracking must be preserved. Form IDs require configuration in Tag Manager, but ownership is unclear, and automatic Google tagging through HubSpot remains uncertain. Split heroes are supported, with the form beside the hero content rather than using a full-width poem. Mobile ordering needs validation because the form typically moves above the content. Existing Figma designs inform implementation, and landing pages will support testing of form placement and conversion experience.

## Keywords
Landing pages, HubSpot forms, Jack Ops, Google Tag Manager, Form placement, Responsive design
